chunks: Mu‘āwiyah ibn ‘Ammār asked Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام:
about a man who performed hajj on behalf of someone else: would that suffice him for the Hajj of Islam?

key_terms.حَجَّةِ الْإِسْلَامِ: the obligatory hajj incumbent in Islam

ai.seo_question: Does performing hajj on behalf of someone else count as one’s own Hajj of Islam?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding hajj performed on behalf of another person. Imam Abū ‘Abdillāh عليه السلام states that such a hajj suffices for the pilgrim as his Hajj of Islam.
